items.scene: A grey-haired lady in a green cardigan happily licks an ICE CREAM sundae piled high in a tall GLASS (GLAHS) at her round marble table.
Two grown-up friends chat at a sunny café TERRACE table (teh-RAHS) under a cream parasol, seen through the open window.
A SUAVE fox in a bow tie (SWAHF) is dying of THIRST, tongue hanging out, reaching a paw for the water jug on his little table.
A bearded juggler in a striped shirt TOSSES (TAHS) a white CUP high into the air with one hand, its saucer ready in the other.
A big green BOA sings a SONG (bwah-SOHN) on a café chair, music notes flying, its coils hugging a bottle of fizzy lemonade DRINK that stands on the seat like a microphone.
A moustached waiter hops on one leg holding his TRAY of cups up FLAT ('plat'), with one more cup balanced on his raised TOE (plah-TOH).
A ZOO giraffe (ZHEW) pokes its head in through the window, its very long straw dipped in a glass of orange JUICE on the sill.
Two BEES THROW (bees-TROH) a sugar cube to each other above the little red-checked tables of the BISTRO.
A granny in spectacles pours pale LIME-BLOSSOM TEA (tee-YUHL) beside a chocolate YULE log, a sprig of yellow linden flowers on her table.
